mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the cost of capital and increase equity valuations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as a tight labor market boosts corporate profits and consumer spending.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when UNRATE is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500.0 thousand units signals a weakening demand for residential construction, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1500.0, or the Rank IC between HOUST and 5-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy faces supply-side headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 105.0, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a rise in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) signals a monetary policy response to inflationary pressures, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates sustained economic growth.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases >0.25pp and CPIAUCSL increases >0.1pp in the past month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases >0.25pp and CPIAUCSL increases >0.1pp, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is less than 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and a rise in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a shift in consumer demand from housing to other sectors, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy diversifies and avoids a housing-led downturn.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below 1500.0 and RSAFS rises above 530000.0
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1500.0 and RSAFS rises above 530000.0, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is less than 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) with accelerating job growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in the past month), the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns as the labor market recovery gains momentum without triggering inflation.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in the past month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is less than 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0) and weak GDP growth (GDPC1 growth < 0.5% in the past quarter), the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day forward returns as the economy faces a potential recession, leading to reduced corporate earnings and risk aversion.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 105.0 and GDPC1 growth < 0.5% in the past quarter
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0 and GDPC1 growth < 0.5%, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is less than 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
